author: Nadia Okafor
purpose: This specification states what the PS-30 bench power supply has to do, so that design, test and the customer work from the same list.
scope: It covers the supply unit, its front panel and its USB interface. Test leads and the bench it stands on are outside it.

definitions.meaning: The pair of 4 mm terminals on the front panel.
The peak-to-peak alternating part of the output voltage, measured over a 20 MHz bandwidth.

facts: The supply will be used on lab benches at ambient temperatures of 0 °C to 40 °C.
Mains will be 230 V ± 10 % at 50 Hz.

requirements.text: The supply shall deliver an output voltage adjustable from 0 V to 30 V in steps of 10 mV.
requirements.rationale: Covers the 24 V circuits the customer tests, with margin.

requirements.text: The supply shall deliver an output current of up to 5 A at any output voltage.
requirements.rationale: The heaviest board under test draws 4.2 A.

requirements.text: The supply shall keep the output ripple below 5 mV peak to peak at an output current of 5 A.
requirements.rationale: The customer's sensor boards read below 10 mV.

requirements.text: The supply shall limit the output current to the set value within 1 ms of a short circuit at the output.
The supply shall have a mass of at most 4.5 kg.
requirements.rationale: One person carries it between benches.

requirements.text: The supply shall convert mains power to output power with an efficiency of at least 85 % at full load (TBR-1).
requirements.rationale: Keeps the case below the temperature a person can touch without a fan.

requirements.text: The supply shall report the measured output voltage and current over USB at least 10 times per second.
requirements.rationale: The customer logs test runs from a PC.

requirements.text: The supply shall hold the accuracy stated in its data sheet at ambient temperatures from 0 °C to 40 °C.
requirements.rationale: The lab is not climate controlled.

goals.text: The supply should run without a fan at output powers up to 50 W.
goals.rationale: Teaching labs prefer a silent bench.

tbd.closes: Efficiency measured on the second prototype

history.change: Ripple and efficiency added after the design review
